about: Defaults of mod-specific recipe load-condition flags, cited from each mod's source at the pinned version (docs/decisions.md, 2026-10-13). Keyed by mod id, the exact version its metadata declares, and condition type. A flag that is not here, or a mod version that is not here, is an unknown load condition: residue, never a guess.
